MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

4. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 15
   C. 8
   D. 7

   C. 30

   B. 2.5

   D. 8

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7

   C. 50
   D. 14

   A. 15

   D. 13

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
